parameters.name: AllUsers
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query service credentials for all Resource Access Management (RAM) users under the Alibaba Cloud account.

If this parameter is set to true, you cannot specify UserPrincipalName at the same time.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first API call.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The service name of the Alibaba Cloud service.

parameters.name: UserPrincipalName
parameters.description:
The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Queries the service credentials of the specified RAM user.
